description:
Join us for an uplifting evening of movement and connection at Ecstatic Dance Aljezur with Pablo Gascon on Saturday, December 19th, at the Essência Nature retreat centre in Aljezur.

Everyone is welcome 🤗 

Schedule:

- 7:00 PM – Warm-up
- 7:15 PM – Ecstatic Dance 
- 8:45 PM – Closing circle

Come as you are to move freely, release, and connect in a welcoming community space.

Entry is 15€, and kids under 16 years old join for free!

Bring your family and friends and come dance with us!!

About DJ & facilitator 

Pablo Gascon is an Ecstatic Dance DJ and facilitator dedicated to creating safe, vibrant spaces for authentic movement and connection. Blending organic rhythms, world beats, and uplifting electronic soundscapes, his sets take dancers on a deeply expressive journey from stillness to peak energy and back into grounding stillness.
